# Subway Seat for Tilix

Palette, cursor, selection highlight, bold and badge colors. Tilix doesn't switch color schemes with the system style, so pick one flavor.

[Tilix](https://gnunn1.github.io/tilix-web/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/tilix/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only tilix
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat.json` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat-tunnel.json` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat-enamel.json` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Subway Seat Enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat-tunnel.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat-enamel.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
